title: Design option bindings
responsibility: Write design alternatives and resolve the exact image bindings belonging to each option.

inputs.name: planOptions.input
inputs.description: Design input with either an images array or 1 to 10 options; directions must be distinct and at most 2000 characters, with images for every option.

inputs.name: planOptions.base
inputs.description: Destination prefix for optional prompt files.

inputs.name: planOptions.files
inputs.description: Mutable file map receiving option prompt text.

inputs.name: planOptions.write
inputs.description: Image writer receiving images and a filename prefix and returning stored image metadata.

inputs.name: checkOptions.version
inputs.description: Stored version whose option numbering and image ownership are checked.

inputs.name: heldBy.version
inputs.description: Version whose image owner is checked.

inputs.name: heldBy.wanted
inputs.description: Optional expected option ID; a different owner is refused.

inputs.name: approvable.version
inputs.description: Version whose approvable image bindings are needed.

inputs.name: approvable.option
inputs.description: Option ID for an optioned version; omitted for a single design.

outputs.name: planOptions
outputs.description: Written images and, when supplied, sequential options with prompt and generator metadata; options cannot share image hashes and any flat images must equal their combined images.

outputs.name: checkOptions
outputs.description: Returns nothing when stored options exactly divide the version images once each with matching hashes and valid metadata.

outputs.name: optionOf
outputs.description: Owning option ID, or undefined for a single design or unmatched file.

outputs.name: heldBy
outputs.description: Object containing the owning option when present, otherwise an empty object.

outputs.name: approvable
outputs.description: Image file/hash bindings for the selected option or all single-design images; null for an invalid selection.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid option input, mismatched stored bindings and a requested option that does not own the image.
